title: NEW MSFS 2024 Aircraft & Free Hardware Profiles! (F-4 Phantom & Sierra C24R)
description:
Are you looking to expand your virtual hangar in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 this week, or are you deciding which new Marketplace add-ons are actually worth your hard-earned cash? Today's marketplace drop delivers a heavy-duty mix of Cold War jet muscle, highly detailed cross-country general aviation touring, propliner expansions, and official plug-and-play hardware integration! Whether you want to light the afterburners in DC Designs' multi-variant F-4 Phantom, explore deep walkaround pre-flight mechanics in Flysimware's updated Beechcraft Sierra C24R, or eliminate controller setup headaches with free manufacturer control profiles, this week's drop has plenty to explore.

In this marketplace breakdown, we take a close look at features, panel variants, realistic expectations, and new releases across the MSFS 2024 virtual flight line:

✈️ HIGH-PERFORMANCE MILITARY & GENERAL AVIATION
We kick things off with frontline Cold War muscle. DC Designs brings their iconic F-4 Phantom family to MSFS 2024, including the F-4E, F-4G Wild Weasel, and British Spey-powered FGR.2. We inspect the native MSFS 2024 visual effects—including G-vapor, heat blur, engine smoke, and icing—alongside custom INS navigation, operational radar modes, Wwise audio, and multi-national liveries. Next, we pivot to general aviation with Flysimware's Beechcraft Sierra C24R. We test the €1 rental option, native CFD prop-wash aerodynamics, steam-to-digital gauge hot-swapping, GPS modularity (G3X, GNS 530, GTN 750), and the fully integrated EFB walkaround mode that lets you physically inspect the engine bay and check the oil!

🎨 LIVERY EXPANSIONS & PREREQUISITE WARNINGS
Looking to refresh your classic hangar? We review new paint schemes for two beloved vintage machines:
- Taylorcraft BC-12D Livery Pack (by ANov): Fresh colorways for the Got Friends classic bush plane.
- L-1049 Super Constellation V2 Liveries: 14 crisp 4K historical liveries (Eastern, Iberia, United, Fly Alaska, and more) plus custom checklists for the Redwing Connie.
⚠️ BUYER'S TIP: Remember that livery packs do not include the underlying aircraft—you must already own the base aircraft from Got Friends or Redwing before buying!

🎮 OFFICIAL HARDWARE CONTROL PROFILES (FREE DOWNLOADS)
Tired of spending hours configuring bindings in MSFS 2024? Both Thrustmaster and Turtle Beach have launched free, official manufacturer control profile packages directly on the Marketplace for PC and Xbox. We examine how these plug-and-play profiles simplify your setup so you can plug in and fly immediately without manual mapping.

Which of these new add-ons are you loading onto the ramp first? Blasting off in the supersonic Phantom, logging cross-country hours in the Sierra C24R, or downloading the free controller profiles? Let us know in the comments below!

If you find these marketplace breakdowns helpful, don't forget to hit that like button, subscribe for weekly flight sim coverage, and clear skies on your next flight!
